root_cause: The NHSUK checkboxes module's exclusive logic requires all checkboxes in the group to have the `data-checkbox-exclusive` attribute to be considered for clearing when the exclusive option is selected. The symptom group's non‑exclusive checkboxes (cough, fever, taste) lacked this attribute, so selecting 'No symptoms' did not clear them.
repair_strategy: Add the `data-checkbox-exclusive` attribute (with an empty value) to the three non‑exclusive symptom checkboxes. This marks them as part of the exclusive group, allowing the module to uncheck them when the exclusive option is chosen, while preserving existing behavior for the contact group and server‑side parameters.

expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can now select the 'No symptoms' option and have any previously selected symptom checkboxes automatically cleared, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard), 2.4.3 (Focus Order), and 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value) by ensuring the form state reflects the correct exclusive choice.
functional_risks: The added attribute is purely for client‑side script; it has no server‑side impact.
If other custom scripts depend on the absence of this attribute, they could be affected, but the risk is low.
verification_requirements: Using only the keyboard, tick a symptom (e.g., cough), then tick 'No symptoms' and confirm that the symptom checkbox is unticked and the form data contains only symptoms[none]=yes.
Using only the keyboard, tick 'No symptoms', then tick a symptom and confirm that the 'No symptoms' checkbox is unticked and the form data contains only the selected symptom.
Verify that the contact group's exclusive behavior (choosing 'Do not contact me' clears text/email) remains unchanged.
Ensure that screen readers announce the correct state changes when the exclusive option is selected.
